title: LIBD spatial data browser
intro: Published spatial transcriptomics and snRNA-seq datasets from the Lieber Institute for Brain Development, viewable in the browser without any installation.

datasets.name: Human amygdala
datasets.description: Visium, Visium HD and Xenium sections of human amygdala with spatial domains, cell types, cell boundaries and two snRNA-seq references (Totty et al. BLA; Yu et al. 2023).

datasets.name: Synthetic demo
datasets.description: Two fake tissue sections plus an embedding, generated by `spatialscape synth`. Loads from GitHub Pages.

datasets.name: Human DLPFC (spatialDLPFC)
datasets.description: Dorsolateral prefrontal cortex: 30 Visium sections across 10 donors with layer-level spatial domains and paired snRNA-seq.

datasets.name: Human hippocampus
datasets.description: Hippocampal formation across 10 donors on Visium with snRNA-seq and Visium-SPG; neuropil domains and subfield annotations.

datasets.name: Locus coeruleus
datasets.description: Locus coeruleus on Visium and snRNA-seq with norepinephrine neuron annotations.
